decisions.reason: Prior R&D investment and alignment with the announced multifunctional packaging direction create sunk-cost and strategic commitment that makes dropping unlikely.
The dated public launch and centrality to reusable carriers make withdrawal highly visible and hard to justify under escalation.
As a flagship launched at SEMICON Europa with strong public commitment and centrality to packaging wafers, escalation pressures make dropping very unlikely.
The publicly announced brand is a flagship close to the core offer, so visible commitment and central strategic direction keep it.
This distant product had no flagship status or public launch, so accumulated commitment and visibility are weakest, making withdrawal easier.
